· SMA100/200 ($46.05/$45.25) comparison — Long-term trend strength above confirmed.

· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $47.70) + Approaching upper band, 47.01% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($45.51) + Support confirmed based on moving averages.
· Swing Resistance ($46.82) + Potential for further upside on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low) + Recovery trend interpretation.
[Volume & Conclusion]

· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend) + 1x target allocation filled, next card is leverage.
